curated.tagline: Sustained production platform — Hetzner, Railway, Cloudflare, Grafana-as-code
curated.description: Pace Server (Pace HQ) is the sustained production platform: Rust/Axum gateway, Go/Chi agent backend, and scaffolded Python/LangGraph reasoning on Supabase Postgres with RLS. Identity, billing (Stripe), and auth (Stytch) are live at pacehq.io and app.pacehq.io. Remaining ~20%: real tool execution and the Python reasoning service — not vapor.

release.transcript: A launch film for Pace, the production platform for identity, billing and AI for small businesses.

showcase.whatItIs: A private business cloud for small businesses: one login, one shell, integrated open-source business apps, and an agent layer that acts across them.
showcase.whoItsFor: Small and mid-sized businesses that want cloud productivity without enterprise complexity.
showcase.whatLukeBuilt: The platform end to end: a Rust/Axum gateway, a Go/Chi control service for entitlements and the agent harness, and a Python/LangGraph reasoning service, on Supabase Postgres with row-level security for tenant isolation. Stripe billing, Stytch auth, a React shell, and Grafana dashboards kept as code.
showcase.status: Private beta, invite-only. Gateway, auth and billing are live at pacehq.io; the agent system is built but not yet taking real actions in production.

highlights: Platform live — gateway, auth, Stripe billing at pacehq.io
Tenant-aware agent pipeline with TierGate and tool registry
Multi-language stack: Rust gateway, Go agents, Python reasoning
Grafana-as-code observability on Railway and Hetzner
curated.architecture: React shell → Rust/Axum gateway → Go/Chi agent backend → Python/LangGraph reasoning → Supabase Postgres + RLS
curated.businessContext: Small businesses need cloud productivity without enterprise complexity. Pace packages identity, billing, and AI into one operator-controlled story on real production infra.
curated.scopeAndScale: Production-stage multi-tenant platform; public surfaces at pacehq.io, app.pacehq.io, observe.pacehq.io, and status.pacehq.io.
engineeringDecisions: Multi-host production — Hetzner compute, Railway app hosting, Cloudflare edge
Grafana-as-code — dashboards and alerts as versioned infrastructure
curated.finishLine: Gateway, auth, and Stripe billing are live (pacehq.io, app.pacehq.io). Remaining ~20%: real tool execution and Python reasoning service hardening — hire is for last-mile finishing.
